title: Report 07: how much email a SaaS sign-up brings in 14 days
population: Business software tools we signed up for in our own test accounts: 64 completed 14-day windows, 2026-10-19 to 2026-11-11.
selection: Not a sample of the market: tools from our review corpus that we tested hands-on with a free plan or trial. A tool counts once its 14-day window has ended; a refused sign-up does not count.

headline.text: median emails per tool in the first 14 days after sign-up

metrics.label: emails in the first two days
tools that emailed an explicit discount
tools that sent no email at all

limitations: Not a random sample: tools we review and could sign up for ourselves.
One mailbox per sign-up; we count mail we can attribute to the vendor without doubt.
Emails include confirmations and onboarding as well as sales mail; we do not classify them here.
Mail removed or archived outside our observation is not counted.
next_full_recheck: with every new completed 14-day window (new edition)
